findings.title: Clipboard physical admission is lost when actual Settings unmounts
reproduction: Hold clipboard.writeText from an explicit Settings copy click.
Navigate to Home while the write remains pending, then return to Settings.
Click Copy in the replacement Settings component; its fresh inFlight=false permits a second physical clipboard write before the first settles.
findings.impact: Violates the packet one-physical-promise claim and permits overlapping pending writes across ordinary route reentry. The actual composition uses the same public generic link, so this is a boundedness/lifecycle contract issue; no private URL leak was found.
findings.remedy: Keep physical clipboard admission for the page lifetime; preserve owner/sequence suppression and manual fallback. Add actual-App held Settings leave/return and held fixture remount-before-settlement controls.
findings.evidence: Per-instance refs are recreated on the App route unmount. The initial native test settles its old promise before mounting a replacement, so its passing unmount assertion covers only stale publication.
findings.resolution: Root corrected physical admission to module/page lifetime with useSyncExternalStore busy snapshots; stale owner and sequence checks unchanged. The final source and added held real-App/fixture remount cases satisfy the original finding.
